description: Create a running average over the most recent window of at most size readings. Example 1: with window size 3, readings 1, 10, 3, and 5 produce averages 1, 5.5, 14/3, and 6. Example 2: with window size 1, readings 4 and 8 produce 4 and 8. Constraints: the window size is positive and readings arrive one at a time.
intuition: Maintain the current window's sum so each new average does not require rescanning its values.

brute_force.approach: Keep all readings and sum the latest window on each request.

optimal.approach: Keep a queue of at most size readings and a running sum, removing the oldest reading when the window fills.

edge_cases: Before the window fills, average all readings received so far.
A size-one window always returns the latest reading.
